comments.text: On defining woke: Woke is one cardinal direction of a two-axis cultural evaluation. On one axis you have Woke <---> Based, and on the other you have Cringe <---> Fire. A woke concept fixates on how it is perceived by others and the approval of others. It undermines the self and the others, first seeking external validation and then attempting to enforce the validated view onto others. A based concept does not care for the approval or participation of others or for external validation. It is internally consistent and makes the self and others more resilient and autonomous. Cringe and fire on the other hand refer to how easily concept spread or are adopted when presented. Fire spreads naturally, while people recoil from cringe.
